passages.citationLabel: Lectures on the History of Philosophy, vol. 1, Introduction A.2, Haldane trans.
passages.translationText: We must know in ancient philosophy or in the philosophy of any given period, what we are going to look for. Or at least we must know that in such a philosophy there is before us a definite stage in the development of thought, and in it those forms and necessities of Mind which lie within the limits of that stage alone are brought into existence.
passages.interpretiveNote: 哲学史中的每一体系都应被理解为思想发展的一个规定阶段；不能脱离其历史限度，把早期体系当成可以原样返回的永恒答案。
